diag.title: Team sync diagnostics
diag.teamMissing: Not in a team, or the team id is missing — team variables cannot sync.
diag.linkMissing: The workspace is not linked to a team directory (symlink missing). Enable/join team sharing in Team Shared settings.
diag.linkDangling: The symlink exists but its target is not accessible (dangling link). The team directory may have been deleted or moved.
diag.secretMissing: This machine has no team secret, so team variables cannot be encrypted/decrypted. Set the correct Team Secret in Team Shared settings.
diag.filesMissing: No encrypted team-variable files under the team directory. They may not have synced from the remote yet (daemon has not pulled), or no one has set a team variable.
diag.other1: The daemon is not running or has not completed a sync, so encrypted files have not been pulled to this machine.
diag.other2: The local team secret differs from the one used to encrypt (members see a "not decrypted" badge).
diag.other3: Team variables are only injected when a new agent session starts; restart the session after changes.
diag.other4: Invalid variable name (team variables allow only lowercase letters, digits, underscores, max 64 chars).

agentRuntime.notStartedDesc: Agent {{shortId}}'s daemon did not respond to runtimeStart (it may be offline or not joined to the team).
agentRuntime.binaryMissingDesc: This team's agent runtime is {{agent}}, but it is not installed on this machine. Pick a runtime that is installed for this team under Settings → Agent, or install {{agent}} first. The runtime is configured per team.
agentRuntime.rpcNotReadyDesc: Unable to send runtimeStart to the daemon. Please check the MQTT connection and team sign-in status.
agentRuntime.deviceOfflineDesc: Agent {{shortId}}'s daemon is offline (MQTT presence). It will retry automatically when the connection returns.
agentRuntime.transportOfflineDesc: Desktop MQTT is disconnected. Runtime start will retry when the broker connection is restored.
agentRuntime.workspaceRpcTimeoutDesc: Agent {{shortId}} did not respond to workspace sync over MQTT within the timeout window.
agentRuntime.workspaceEnsureFailedDesc: Agent {{shortId}}: failed to sync the workspace with the daemon before starting.
agentRuntime.sessionParticipantFailedDesc: Could not add agent {{shortId}} to this session, so its runtime was not started. The agent must be a session participant before it can read the session. ({{reason}})
agentRuntime.emptyReply: Agent returned no output. The selected model may be unavailable or misconfigured.
agentRuntime.providerStalled: The model provider stopped responding. It may be unavailable or rate-limited — please retry or switch models.
agentRuntime.providerError: The model provider reported an error. Please retry or switch models.

connection.tokenExchangeFailed: amuxd daemon HTTP started but authentication failed: restart amuxd and try again.
connection.healthCheckFailed: amuxd daemon HTTP is not responding: confirm the amuxd process is still running.
connection.notConnected: amuxd daemon not connected: confirm amuxd is started and the HTTP control plane is available.
